name: Shutterchance Love
original_name: シャッターチャンス・ラブ
source:
Makoto always enjoyed the art of photography; that's why he joined the photography club while in high school. However, he appears to be the only male student that's interested in such things. Much to everyone else's loss; each of the student members, as well as the teacher in charge, are all female hotties. Somehow club incurs a sizable debt during summer vacation. Running out of options to repay the sum, the idea of taking lewd photographs comes on the table. Well, it looks like the ladies will have to take one for the team!

[From White Masq]
